result.instructions: Tools for Kizeo Forms, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which forms do we have in Kizeo Forms, and what fields does the inspection form use?"; "Show me the submissions from the last week of the site-visit form that mention a leak."; "Get the unread submissions for the CRM sync action and mark the ones I give you as read.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kizeo Forms data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kizeo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kizeo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kizeo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kizeo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kizeo_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List all forms in the Kizeo Forms account with their ids and names. Good first call to find a form_id. REST: GET /forms.

tools.name: kizeo_get_form
tools.title: Get a form definition
tools.description: Get one form's complete definition: its fields, their types and ids. Use it to read field names before filtering data. REST: GET /forms/{formId}.

tools.name: kizeo_search_form_data
tools.title: Search form data
tools.description: List the data records (submissions) of a form, with optional advanced filters and ordering. Pass form_id `all` to search every form. Filter `operator` values are passed to Kizeo unchanged. REST: POST /forms/{formId}/data/advanced.

form_id.description: Form id, or `all` for every form.

global_filters.description: Free-text filter applied to all fields.

field.description: Field name, as shown in kizeo_get_form.

operator.description: Operator name, as Kizeo Forms expects it.

type.description: Field type, as Kizeo Forms expects it.

tools.name: kizeo_get_form_data
tools.title: Get one data record
tools.description: Get one data record (a submission) of a form, with all its field values and media names. REST: GET /forms/{formId}/data/{dataId}.

tools.name: kizeo_get_unread_data
tools.title: Get unread data
tools.description: Get the data records of a form that this action has not read yet, up to `limit`. Mark the ones you handled with kizeo_mark_data_read. REST: GET /forms/{formId}/data/unread/{action}/{limit}.

action.description: Action name: a label that tracks which consumer has read the data, for example `crm-sync`.

include_updated.description: Also return records edited since the last read (vendor flag includeupdated).

tools.name: kizeo_mark_data_read
tools.title: Mark data as read
tools.description: Mark data records as read for one action, so kizeo_get_unread_data stops returning them for that action. Repeating the call has no further effect. REST: POST /forms/{formId}/markasreadbyaction/{action}.

action.description: Action name: a label that tracks which consumer has read the data, for example `crm-sync`.

data_ids.description: Data ids to mark, up to 100 per call.

tools.name: kizeo_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the Kizeo Forms account. The token's user may need administrator rights to see all users. REST: GET /users.

tools.name: kizeo_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the groups of the Kizeo Forms account. REST: GET /groups.

tools.name: kizeo_list_external_lists
tools.title: List external lists
tools.description: List the external lists (reference lists that the mobile forms use) with their ids and names. REST: GET /lists.

tools.name: kizeo_get_external_list
tools.title: Get an external list
tools.description: Get one external list's definition, including its items. REST: GET /lists/{listId}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Kizeo Forms
prompts.description: What you can do with Kizeo Forms here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_a_form_and_its_fields
prompts.title: Find a form and its fields
prompts.description: List the forms of the account, then read one form's definition with its fields and field types.

prompts.name: search_submitted_data
prompts.title: Search submitted data
prompts.description: Search the data records of one form, or of all forms, with advanced filters and ordering. Read one record with its field values.

prompts.name: work_through_unread_submissions
prompts.title: Work through unread submissions
prompts.description: Read the unread records for one action, up to a limit. Then mark the records you handled as read for that action.

prompts.name: read_users_groups_and_external_lists
prompts.title: Read users, groups and external lists
prompts.description: List the users and groups of the account. List the external lists, and read one list with its items.
